title: FERC Compliance Directives — Docket P-2551-000: Letter to American Electric Power discussing the 06/03/2026 Dam Safety Inspection, 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Report, and Public Safety Plan for the Buchanan Hydroelectric Project under P-2551.
text:
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
Office of Energy Projects
Division of Dam Safety and Inspections
Chicago Regional Office
In reply refer to: P-2551
July 2, 2026
VIA ELECTRONIC MAIL
Mr. Gene F. Sirca, Jr., Ph.D., P.E., S.E.
Chief Hydro Dam Safety Engineer
American Electric Power
gfsirca@aep.com
Re: Buchanan Hydroelectric Project, FERC No. 2551
- 2026 Dam Safety Inspection (DSI) – Post Inspection Letter
- 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Report (DSSMR)
Dear Mr. Sirca:
The 2026 Dam Safety Inspection (DSI) of Buchanan Hydroelectric Project,
FERC No. 2551, was conducted on June 3, 2026, by Mr. Eduardo Prieto, P.E.. He was
accompanied by Mses. Justine Penix and Jodi Slough, and Messrs. Rich Walag, Erwin
Supranata, Rob Beller, Craig Bonesteel, Danny Fleming and yourself of American
Electric Power (AEP). Based on our inspection, it was concluded that no immediate dam
safety-related items need to be addressed. Be advised that we may provide you with
comments that develop as a result of our preparation of the dam safety inspection report.
The 2025 Dam Safety Surveillance and Monitoring Report (DSSMR), prepared by
HDR, was received with AEP’s April 1, 2026 submittal and was reviewed following the
inspection. The DSSMR recommends repairing the deteriorated spalled and cracked
concrete as needed as part of the current maintenance program. Please provide a status
update in the next DSSMR submittal.
The DSSMR includes a statement from the Chief Dam Safety Engineer that the
dam is safe for continued operation. Our review finds the 2025 DSSMR fulfils the
requirements in Chapter 14 –Dam Safety Performance Monitoring Program, Appendix K
of the FERC Engineering Guidelines for the Evaluation of Hydropower Projects. The
2026 DSSMR is due by April 1, 2027.
Our records indicated that the Public Safety Plan (PSP) for the Buchanan project
was filed on January 13, 2015, and is more than 10 years old. Consistent with the
Commission’s public safety guidelines and standard dam safety practices, Public Safety

Plans older than ten years must be reviewed, updated, and resubmitted to ensure that
public safety measures reflect current site conditions and operational practices.
In accordance with 18 CFR § 12.52, it is your responsibility to take all reasonable
measures to maintain and operate your hydropower project in a manner that is safe for the
public. As part of this update, you should reassess potential public safety hazards
associated with the project and evaluate the adequacy of existing safety measures. Any
additional measures necessary to protect the public should be identified and put into place
as appropriate.
The Public Safety Plan should be updated and filed to this office by December 31,
2026. Further details regarding Public Safety are available at
https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2020-04/public-safety.pdf
File your submittal using the Commission’s eFiling system at
https://www.ferc.gov/ferc-online/overview. When eFiling, select Hydro: Dam Safety and
Chicago Regional Office from the eFiling menu. The cover page of the filing must
indicate that the material was eFiled. For assistance with eFiling, contact FERC Online
Support at FERCOnlineSupport@ferc.gov, (866) 208-3676 (toll free), or (202) 502-8659
(TTY).
You may contact Mr. Eduardo Prieto at 312.596.4449 (Eduardo.Prieto@ferc.gov)
or me at (312) 596-4456 or if you have questions.
Sincerely,
Marilyn Sabido, P.E.
Regional Engineer
